name: Daniel Sobhani
headline: CEO/Founder of Freeletics/Stædium | CDTM | Father & Explorer
summary:
Since 2013, our vision at Freeletics has been to challenge and inspire people to become the greatest version of themselves. Today, with over 50 million users worldwide, we offer leading, hyper-personalized and AI-driven digital personal coaching.

With Stædium, we have built the first fully gamified strength training system. Turning your workout from a must, to a want. To destroy boring.

Personally, I am dedicated to supporting people to live THIS ONE LIFE: Body. Business. Mind. Relationship. Through inspiration, knowledge and solutions.

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description:
www.staedium.com

STÆDIUM is the ultimate out-of-the-gym solution and a completely new workout concept. Welcome to “strength gaming,” a functional strength workout and a game experience in one. We’ve brought the two together by combining premium home training equipment and AI-powered tracking hardware in a beautiful, intelligent design. Our mission is to Destroy Boring, and your strength workouts will never be the same again.

positions.description: Freeletics is a leading sports- and lifestyle company. We challenge and inspire people to become the greatest version of themselves - both physically and mentally. With a community of over 50 million people worldwide, we help people develop the tools necessary to shape their life according to their goals and needs - the basis of living a fulfilled life. Freeletics is a platform to educate and motivate, offering the most intelligent and efficient digital fitness coaching in the world, helping people build confidence, physical fitness and willpower.
